verdict.rationale: Docs mention Cloudflare Workers ships with 'built-in observability' for deep visibility and insight, which touches the observability theme, but there is no evidence of visitor-behavior tracking, traffic/analytics dashboards, or performance metrics presented to a devops-lead. Missing for 10: dedicated analytics/dashboard evidence, visitor behavior metrics (page views, referrers, geo), and independent confirmation of the observability feature's depth.
